_help: One entry per project; the site rebuilds from this file on every push (see README). Fields: title, kind, status (live | building | open | private | research | experience), summary, value (the business value: what it can do for the people who use it), impact (short bullets, optional), tags, filters (work, insurance, platform, security, learning), featured (true = on Home), homeOnly (true = only on Home), cover { theme (mustek | birdview | stayvinci | aegis | insurance | movit | security | platform | learning | realestate), logo (image path) or wordmark (text), headline, tagline, stat ["number", "label"] (optional hero number), icon (optional illustration: layers | face | coins | box | chat | search | pulse | mail | doc | returns | map | home | cube | chart | cap | shield), mockup (optional screenshot of the project's own UI, 640x360) }, caseStudy (optional page), links (label, url, icon: github | gitlab | external), privateCode.

Photos 77% lighter with a WebP pipeline
Consent-based personalisation, careers with CV upload

projects.title: Stayvinci

Four apps on one typed API
30 showcase stores for end-to-end demos

projects.title: Microinsurance experience
projects.summary: At Birdview Microinsurance: facial recognition attendance, financial transactions, customer notifications and an asset registry. Plus my own fraud detection and InsureLog services.
projects.value: Systems that protect an insurer's margins and time: automated attendance for 50+ staff, audited transactions, faster customer communication, and fraud caught before it's paid.

cover.headline: Stop fraud. Serve faster. Account for every shilling.

projects.title: AEGIS
projects.summary: An authorization-first, read-only assessment suite and money-integrity monitor: nothing runs outside a signed scope, and every action is logged.
projects.value: Can catch money leaks early (bets paid twice, replayed M-Pesa receipts, payouts above stake × odds) and produces evidence a lawyer can rely on.
impact: Tamper-evident, hash-chained audit log
Zero dependencies: pure Python standard library

projects.title: Facial Recognition Attendance
projects.summary: Employee attendance platform built at Birdview Microinsurance: staff check in and out by face, with identity verified by MTCNN and SSD MobileNet models.
projects.value: Automated check-in and check-out for 50+ staff: no queues at a register, no buddy-punching, and HR gets attendance reports and analytics instead of spreadsheets.
impact: Face detection and verification (MTCNN, SSD MobileNet)
APIs for attendance logging, authentication, reporting and analytics
Analytics dashboards for HR

projects.title: Financial Transaction Management
projects.summary: Backend for internal financial transactions at Birdview Microinsurance: validated database updates and a full audit trail.
projects.value: Fewer reconciliation errors and a clear answer to "who changed this and when" for every entry, which auditors and finance teams rely on.
impact: Validation workflows for consistent transaction data
Audit trails across 100+ transaction entries

projects.title: Asset Registry
projects.summary: Asset lifecycle management at Birdview Microinsurance: register, assign, track and retire organisational assets.
projects.value: Digitised tracking for 200+ assets: the company knows what it owns, where it is and who has it, cutting losses and audit time.
impact: Lifecycle tracking from purchase to retirement
Replaced manual tracking workflows

projects.title: Customer Care Notification System
projects.summary: Multi-channel platform built at Birdview Microinsurance to reach customers by SMS and email: one-off messages, bulk campaigns from CSV lists, templates and delivery tracking.
projects.value: Cut manual communication delays: policyholders hear about payments, renewals and claims on the channel they read, thousands at a time, with proof of delivery.

projects.title: Microinsurance Fraud Detection
projects.summary: Scores each insurance claim for fraud risk, explains why it was flagged, and gives analysts a dashboard to decide.
projects.value: Can stop fraudulent claims before they're paid, and lets analysts spend their time on the risky few instead of reviewing every claim.
impact: Plugs in front of any claims system via REST
Explainable 0–1 risk score, not a black box

cover.headline: Catch fraud before it's paid.
cover.tagline: Explainable risk scores for every claim

projects.title: InsureLog
projects.summary: A plug-and-play logging toolkit for insurance microservices: one dependency gives every Spring Boot service structured events.
projects.value: Can cut the time to answer "what happened to my claim?" from hours of digging to minutes, while keeping customers' personal data out of the logs.
impact: Automatic personal-data masking
Correlation IDs follow a customer across services
Central search, export and Grafana dashboard

projects.title: Training Attendance System
projects.summary: Replaces a paper HR attendance form: employees sign in with a drawn signature, and finished sessions become branded PDFs on a helpdesk ticket.
projects.value: Retires paper forms and manual filing: every training session leaves an audit-ready record on its own, and HR stops chasing signatures.
impact: QR sign-in and an offline queue
PDF auto-attached to Freshservice
Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on

projects.title: Sales Returns Portal

impact: Webhook plus a 5-minute safety sweep: no approval missed
Bulk upsert of one deal per item
